title: gradient
body:
## gradient

Estimates the spatial gradient of a point or cell array and stores it as a new array on the same mesh: 3 components for a scalar, 9 (row-major d(component)/d(x, y, z)) for a 3-component vector. Optionally adds divergence, vorticity and the Q-criterion of a vector field, e.g. for vortex identification. Unstructured meshes use cell derivatives, structured ones central differences. Use pvGradient for the full native settings and other output names.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Divergence, vorticity and Q-criterion need a 3-component array; they fail or are skipped for scalars.
- Derivatives are in field units per dataset length unit; no unit conversion is applied.

Native constructor: `Gradient`. Identity: `curated binding`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: Specify the input to the Gradient filter. Accepted data: any dataset (meshes, grids, point sets) (vtkDataSet); hyper-tree grids (adaptive AMR-like trees) (vtkHyperTreeGrid). The input needs at least one point- or cell-centred array. | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataSet","vtkHyperTreeGrid"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `field` | Specify the name of the scalar array from which to compute the gradient. | `{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string","minLength":1},"minItems":2,"maxItems":2}` | `required` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE","REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `result` | Provide a name for the output array containing the gradient vectors. | `{"type":"string"}` | `"gradient"` | `"gradient"` |
| `gradient` | If on, the gradient of the input array is computed. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `true` | `true` |
| `divergence` | If on, the divergence of a 3-component array is computed. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `false` | `false` |
| `vorticity` | If on, the vorticity/curl of a 3-component array is computed. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `false` | `false` |
| `qCriterion` | If on, the Q-criterion of a 3-component array is computed. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `false` | `false` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "gradient",
  "inputs": {
    "input": "UPSTREAM_input"
  },
  "options": {
    "field": [
      "REPLACE_WITH_VALUE",
      "REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"
    ]
  }
}
```
